subject: mathematics
concept: Choosing the right unit for length (cm vs m) based on the size of the object
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student measures on-screen objects of varying size with a virtual ruler/tape
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts pictured objects into 'measure in cm' vs 'measure in m' bins
exercise.abstract: Student selects the correct unit (cm or m) for a described object

misconception_flags: uses cm for very large objects or m for very small ones

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
